intention: 为我介绍Netapp的投资者,以及他们投资的具体情况
statement:
MATCH (node)-[:PART_OF]->(form:Form),
      (form)<-[:FILED]-(company:Company)

CALL {
    WITH company
    MATCH (company)<-[owns:OWNS_STOCK_IN]-(manager:Manager)
    WITH manager.managerName AS managerName, owns.shares AS shares, owns.value AS value
    ORDER BY shares DESC
    LIMIT 10
    RETURN collect(managerName) AS managers,
           collect(shares) AS sharesList,
           collect(value) AS valuesList
}

RETURN 
    node.text AS text,
    score AS similarityScore,
    company.companyName AS companyName,
    managers,
    sharesList,
    valuesList,
    {
        source: node.source,
        formId: form.formId,
        f10kItem: form.f10kItem
    } AS metadata
